tutorial.title: Five-lesson tutorial
tutorial.intro: Five progressive lessons teach the core rules through short guided scenarios. Exordium covers combat and tactics; Nexus covers Starters, unit types, the deployment network, and Vanguard; Agathoi covers Thorns, Counterattack, fortification, and Strategic Point defense.
tutorial.fieldTestsIntro: The five Challenges independently test what you have learned. They are visible from the start and unlock together after all five guided lessons are completed.
tutorial.gateLocked: Academy {completed}/{required} · Field tests locked: complete all {required} guided lessons to unlock them.
tutorial.academyCompletedDetail: Academy completed. You can now take the first Field test.
tutorial.progressSavedDetail: Progress saved. You can continue directly to the next lesson.
tutorial.challengeNextDetail: Objective achieved. You can continue directly to the next Field test.
tutorial.allChallengesCompleteDetail: Objective achieved. All Field tests are complete.
tutorial.wrongAction: That is not the action required by this step.
tutorial.interrupted: Tutorial interrupted. The checkpoint remains available.
tutorial.targetUnavailable: This step was unavailable. The interface has been released: resume from the checkpoint or restart the lesson.

lesson-1-exordium.title: Cards, combat, and tactics
lesson-1-exordium.summary: Learn to read a card, manage your Hand, deploy units, deplete DEF, use an active ability, and play EMP Missile.

lesson-2-nexus.title: Starters, units, and the deployment network
lesson-2-nexus.summary: Starters, unit types, Vanguard, and two procedures for reaching the central Strategic Point.

lesson-3-agathoi.title: Defending the Strategic Point
lesson-3-agathoi.summary: Card selection, Thorns, Counterattack, fortification, and holding out against three waves.

lesson-4-liberti.title: Coordinated assault
lesson-4-liberti.summary: Bleeding, Numerical Superiority, and capturing a Strategic Point defended by the Agathoi.

lesson-5-fabeot.title: Contracts, vulnerability, and acquisition
lesson-5-fabeot.summary: Mark a vulnerable target, control the Hand, disrupt ENE, and convert an enemy unit.

wave-1.label: Wave I
wave-1.message: Two Nexus Starter units enter the area.

wave-2.label: Wave II
wave-2.message: Two more Nexus Starter units enter the area.

challenge-2-hold-ps.title: Field test II · Hold
challenge-2-hold-ps.objective: Hold the central SP for 3 consecutive turns of your own
challenge-2-hold-ps.introMessage: Capture the central SP and hold it for 3 consecutive turns of your own. You have a fixed hand and no deck, so use your cards well. Six Exordium Starter units will arrive in three waves of two.

wave-1.label: Wave I
wave-1.message: The first pair of Exordium Starters advances toward the center.

wave-2.label: Wave II
wave-2.message: The second pair enters: the central position must hold.

wave-3.label: Wave III
wave-3.message: The final pair of Exordium Starters. Maintain control through the third valid turn.

challenge-3-hq-breach.title: Field test III · Breach
challenge-3-hq-breach.objective: Occupy the Nexus HQ with an Exordium unit
challenge-3-hq-breach.introMessage: Open a path to the Nexus HQ. You have 3 units in play, 5 cards in hand, and a reduced 10-card deck. There is no Starter reserve, Mission, or deck recovery: the test ends when one of your units enters the enemy HQ.

defense-line.label: Nexus line
defense-line.message: Four Nexus units defend the route to the HQ. Break through and keep advancing.

challenge-4-pressure.title: Field test IV · Pressure
challenge-4-pressure.objective: Win through Pressure: central SP + at least 2/3 SPs until Pressure 5
challenge-4-pressure.introMessage: The test begins on round 20, with Pressure already active in Fast mode. Dycaios holds the center and the Hoplite holds the northern SP: keep the central SP and at least 2 of the 3 SPs until Pressure 5. You have 5 cards in hand and a finite 20-card deck; there is no Mission, Starter reserve, or deck recovery.

pressure-opposition.label: Exordium line
pressure-opposition.message: Exordium controls the southern SP and threatens the center. Maintain the required majority until the Pressure victory.

challenge-5-final-exam.title: Field test V · Final exam
challenge-5-final-exam.objective: Win a full match against Nexus Advanced
challenge-5-final-exam.introMessage: You are now playing Arena Rubra without special Challenge rules: Starter Battlefield, Fast mode, Exordium against Nexus Advanced. Hand, regulation deck, Starter reserve, ENE, draws, deck recovery, and victory conditions all use the standard match runtime. Win through any valid core condition.

challenge-1-elimination.title: Elimination
challenge-1-elimination.subtitle: Field test I
challenge-1-elimination.summary: Units only. Destroy 4 Nexus starter units in 2 waves of 2.

challenge-2-hold-ps.title: Hold
challenge-2-hold-ps.subtitle: Field test II
challenge-2-hold-ps.summary: Fixed units and hand, with no deck draws. Hold the central SP for 3 of your turns while 6 enemy starter units arrive.
challenge-2-hold-ps.objective: Hold the central SP for 3 turns

challenge-3-hq-breach.title: Breach
challenge-3-hq-breach.subtitle: Field test III
challenge-3-hq-breach.summary: Units, a starting hand, and a 10-card deck. Open a path and occupy the enemy HQ.

challenge-4-pressure.title: Pressure
challenge-4-pressure.subtitle: Field test IV
challenge-4-pressure.summary: Units, a starting hand, and a 20-card deck. Win the match through Pressure.

challenge-5-final-exam.title: Final exam
challenge-5-final-exam.subtitle: Field test V
challenge-5-final-exam.summary: A full Fast match on Starter Battlefield against Nexus Advanced: no special rules, using the standard Arena Rubra runtime.
